Enum Class Orientation

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<Orientation>
dev.despical.pixelpainter.core.Orientation
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Orientation>, Constable
public enum Orientation extends Enum<Orientation>
Maps top-to-bottom image pixels into vertical walls or horizontal floor art.

The origin is the bottom-left image block. Columns extend along the selected right vector; source row zero lies at the far end of the image-up vector. Vertical names identify the outward-facing normal of a wall.
